review:
Honestly... I don't know how to feel about this. It's nothing special, the scenario doesn't seems a bit interesting. 

It did got me a bit interested in the other episode, but not enough to buy them.

Pretty well made stuff! 

The story is intriguing enough that I'm willing to pay for the next chapters. It's written with taste and the dialogues don't let too much interrogation out of the way. Meaning, you don't end up questioning the conclusions of the characters ; it really feels like investigators talking. It make sense, and that helps a bunch to set the mood. As far as visual goes, it's not the most impressive pixel-art I have seen and the art direction is a bit shy in my opinion. But on the other hand it really is so polished and neatly done that it paints a good picture nonetheless. 
Oh and the music is really good. Not overly original being a piano score for the most part, but so efficient for the atmosphere.


TL;DR
Good investigation adventure so far, and free for the first chapter. Try it out!
